title: A Language Goes Extinct Every 2 Weeks
hook: A language goes extinct about every two weeks.
closing: Each lost language erases knowledge and a way of seeing the world.
question: Which languages do you speak?

segments.say: About four in ten languages are endangered, often depending on their last fluent speakers.
Languages vanish about six times faster than last century—roughly one every two weeks.
Half of today's languages could disappear by 2100, taking unique knowledge with them.
